profiles.notes: 2026/2027 direct secondary entry. Published Tanzanian ACSEE scores and programme subjects use the local system.

requirements.label: Direct entry · required subjects and ACSEE points
requirements.details: Choose two principal passes from History, Geography, Kiswahili, English Language, French, Arabic, Fine Arts, Economics, Commerce, Accountancy, Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Advanced Mathematics, Agriculture, Computer Science or Nutrition. For History and English, provide principal or subsidiary passes, or the published O-level fallback of at least C. The TCU 2026/2027 table lists a minimum of 5 ACSEE points across three subjects.

source.title: TCU secondary guide 2026/2027, printed p. 289, UD052

requirements.label: Direct entry · required subjects and ACSEE points
requirements.details: Use principal passes in Advanced Mathematics and Economics. The TCU 2026/2027 table lists a minimum of 5 ACSEE points across three subjects.

source.title: TCU secondary guide 2026/2027, printed p. 290, UD054

requirements.label: Direct entry · required subjects and ACSEE points
requirements.details: Present principal passes in Mathematics and Physics. Use a subsidiary pass in Chemistry or an O-level Chemistry credit. The TCU 2026/2027 table lists a minimum of 4.0 ACSEE points.

source.title: TCU secondary guide 2026/2027, printed p. 290, UD055

requirements.label: Direct entry · required subjects and ACSEE points
requirements.details: Present principal passes in Advanced Mathematics and Physics. Also provide at least a subsidiary pass in Chemistry. The guide lists physical fitness as a special requirement. The TCU 2026/2027 table lists a minimum of 4.5 ACSEE points.

source.title: TCU secondary guide 2026/2027, printed p. 291, UD060

requirements.label: Direct entry · required subjects and ACSEE points
requirements.details: Pair a principal Chemistry pass with principal Biology, Physics, Advanced Mathematics, Nutrition, Agriculture or Geography. O-level Chemistry and Physics must both be C or higher. The TCU 2026/2027 table lists a minimum of 4.0 ACSEE points.

source.title: TCU secondary guide 2026/2027, printed p. 291, UD061

requirements.label: Direct entry · required subjects and ACSEE points
requirements.details: Present principal passes in Advanced Mathematics and Physics. The TCU 2026/2027 table lists a minimum of 4.0 ACSEE points.

requirements.label: Direct entry · required subjects and ACSEE points
requirements.details: Choose two principal passes from Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Mathematics, Geography or Fine Arts. The TCU 2026/2027 table lists a minimum of 4.0 ACSEE points.

source.title: TCU secondary guide 2026/2027, printed p. 292, UD063

requirements.label: Direct entry · required subjects and ACSEE points
requirements.details: Present two arts principal passes and an A-level General Studies credit. O-level Biology and Civics both need credits. The TCU 2026/2027 table lists a minimum of 5 ACSEE points across three subjects.

source.title: TCU secondary guide 2026/2027, printed p. 293, UD066

requirements.label: Direct entry · required subjects and ACSEE points
requirements.details: Use two principal passes in arts or science and provide an O-level Biology credit. The TCU 2026/2027 table lists a minimum of 5 ACSEE points across three subjects.

requirements.label: Direct entry · required subjects and ACSEE points
requirements.details: Choose two principal passes from Business Studies, Tourism or the following subjects: History, Geography, Kiswahili, English Language, French, Arabic, Fine Arts, Economics, Commerce, Accountancy, Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Advanced Mathematics, Agriculture, Computer Science or Nutrition. The TCU 2026/2027 table lists a minimum of 5 ACSEE points across three subjects.

requirements.label: Direct entry · required subjects and ACSEE points
requirements.details: Combine principal Chemistry with Mathematics, Biology, Nutrition, Physics or Geography. The programme also asks for an O-level Mathematics credit and lists a compulsory A-level subsidiary pass. The TCU 2026/2027 table lists a minimum of 4.0 ACSEE points.

source.title: TCU secondary guide 2026/2027, printed p. 295, UD074

requirements.label: Direct entry · required subjects and ACSEE points
requirements.details: Combine a principal pass in Biology with one in Chemistry, Nutrition, Agriculture, Physics or Geography. The TCU 2026/2027 table lists a minimum of 4.0 ACSEE points.

requirements.label: Direct entry · required subjects and ACSEE points
requirements.details: Use principal passes in Advanced Mathematics and in Physics, Chemistry or Geography. At O level, show D or higher in Physics and in a second listed subject such as Chemistry, Biology or Science and Practice in Agriculture. The TCU 2026/2027 table lists a minimum of 4.0 ACSEE points.

source.title: TCU secondary guide 2026/2027, printed p. 296, UD076

requirements.label: Direct entry · required subjects and ACSEE points
requirements.details: Use Economics as one principal pass and choose the other from Commerce, Agriculture, Geography or Advanced Mathematics. The TCU 2026/2027 table lists a minimum of 4.0 ACSEE points.

requirements.label: Direct entry · required subjects and ACSEE points
requirements.details: Use principal Advanced Mathematics and another principal pass in Physics, Geography, Chemistry or Computer Science. When the second subject is not Physics, a subsidiary pass in Physics is required. The TCU 2026/2027 table lists a minimum of 4.0 ACSEE points.

source.title: TCU secondary guide 2026/2027, printed p. 297, UD079

requirements.label: Direct entry · required subjects and ACSEE points
requirements.details: Earn principal passes of D or higher in each of Physics, Chemistry and Biology. The TCU 2026/2027 table lists a minimum of 6.0 ACSEE points.

requirements.label: Direct entry · required subjects and ACSEE points

requirements.label: Direct entry · required subjects and ACSEE points

requirements.label: Direct entry · required subjects and ACSEE points
